/**

 * TASK: Implement secure Route Guards with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

 *

 * GOAL

 * ----

 * Protect all private routes according to user roles.

 * Prevent unauthorized access after login.

 * Redirect users automatically to the correct dashboard.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * USER ROLES

 * ==========================================

 *

 * There are only 3 roles:

 *

 * - admin

 * - doctor

 * - patient

 *

 * The authenticated user role comes from the database

 * (Supabase Auth + profiles/users table).

 *

 * Never hardcode roles.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * LOGIN FLOW

 * ==========================================

 *

 * After successful login:

 *

 * if role === "admin"

 *     -> /admin/dashboard

 *

 * if role === "doctor"

 *     -> /doctor/dashboard

 *

 * if role === "patient"

 *     -> /dashboard

 *

 * If role is missing

 * redirect to:

 *

 * /auth

 *

 * and show:

 *

 * "Unable to determine your account type."

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * PUBLIC ROUTES

 * ==========================================

 *

 * These pages must stay public:

 *

 * /

 * /about

 * /services

 * /team

 * /doctors

 * /contact

 * /pricing

 * /appointment

 * /faq

 * /blog

 * /privacy

 * /terms

 * /404

 *

 * No authentication required.

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * PROTECTED ROUTES

 * ==========================================

 *

 * PATIENT

 *

 * /dashboard

 * /appointments

 * /medical-records

 * /profile

 * /billing

 *

 * accessible ONLY by:

 *

 * patient

 *

 *

 * DOCTOR

 *

 * /doctor/*

 *

 * accessible ONLY by:

 *

 * doctor

 *

 *

 * ADMIN

 *

 * /admin/*

 *

 * accessible ONLY by:

 *

 * admin

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * BLOCK ACCESS

 * ==========================================

 *

 * If a patient tries:

 *

 * /admin/*

 *

 * redirect:

 *

 * /dashboard

 *

 *

 * If doctor tries:

 *

 * /admin/*

 *

 * redirect:

 *

 * /doctor/dashboard

 *

 *

 * If admin tries:

 *

 * /dashboard

 *

 * redirect:

 *

 * /admin/dashboard

 *

 *

 * If not logged in:

 *

 * redirect:

 *

 * /auth

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * CREATE COMPONENT

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Create reusable:

 *

 * <ProtectedRoute />

 *

 * Props:

 *

 * allowedRoles=[]

 *

 * Example:

 *

 * <ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["admin"]}>

 *      <AdminLayout/>

 * </ProtectedRoute>

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * AUTH LOADING

 * ==========================================

 *

 * While session is loading:

 *

 * Show centered loader

 *

 * Do NOT flash protected pages.

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * SESSION

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Listen to:

 *

 * onAuthStateChange()

 *

 * Automatically update permissions.

 *

 * Handle refresh.

 *

 * Handle browser reload.

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * LOGOUT

 * ==========================================

 *

 * On logout:

 *

 * clear session

 * clear cached profile

 *

 * redirect:

 *

 * /auth

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * SIDEBAR

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Sidebar menus should change automatically.

 *

 * Admin sees only:

 *

 * Dashboard

 * Patients

 * Doctors

 * Appointments

 * Billing

 * Inventory

 * Reports

 * Settings

 *

 *

 * Doctor sees only:

 *

 * Dashboard

 * My Patients

 * Calendar

 * Medical Records

 * Profile

 *

 *

 * Patient sees only:

 *

 * Dashboard

 * Appointments

 * Medical Records

 * Invoices

 * Profile

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * SECURITY

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Never rely only on frontend.

 *

 * Verify role using database before rendering.

 *

 * If database role changes,

 * UI updates automatically.

 *

 * Users must never access another role dashboard

 * by typing the URL manually.

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * DATABASE

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Read role from:

 *

 * profiles.role

 *

 * or

 *

 * users.role

 *

 * depending on the existing schema.

 *

 * Keep everything synchronized with Supabase Auth.

 *

 *

 * ==========================================

 * RESULT

 * ==========================================

 *

 * ✔ Secure role-based routing

 * ✔ No unauthorized access

 * ✔ Automatic redirects

 * ✔ Clean reusable ProtectedRoute component

 * ✔ Loading state

 * ✔ Session persistence

 * ✔ Sidebar adapts to role

 * ✔ Compatible with React Router + Supabase

 * ✔ Production-ready implementation

 */
